# Provenance: lunar absolute-station observability, NumPy oracle

- `inputs.json`: Kshana's own committed inputs, written by
  `cargo run --example gen_lunar_observability_fixture` on 2026-10-01 (pre-registration commit
  `fab02df9`): for 17 configurations of the lunar joint orbit-and-clock solve, the central
  finite-difference measurement Jacobian `H`, the weights `1/sigma^2` and the stored-unit scale
  that `kshana::lunar_combination::lunar_observability` analyses. SHA-256
  `055fdf335dfec761a922720eaf6274d3009f708ca4e8b9e1a0d481d92138bc22`. The test asserts the engine
  still builds exactly these inputs.
- `reference.json`: the oracle output of `gen_reference.py`, run once on 2026-10-01 after that
  commit. SHA-256 `ed57fd6b3cc093dd1a0e5f4abf1a1a258afe0ea56c760402aea0f9a22b8eb6bd`
  (`gen_reference.py` `dae4b3f17b98f22b3183c08234ecc9ef450b21f38f1163fa2df28495f9819eea`).
- **Tool:** NumPy 2.3.5 and SciPy 1.18.1 (BSD-3-Clause; `numpy.linalg.svd`, `numpy.linalg.inv`,
  `numpy.linalg.pinv`, `scipy.linalg.null_space`, LAPACK-backed) in `$ORACLE_PY` of
  `~/Code/kshana-oracles/env.sh`. Run as a separate program; nothing from it is linked into kshana.
- **Licence of these files:** generated by this project (AGPL-3.0-only, as the repository).
- **Reproduce:** `source ~/Code/kshana-oracles/env.sh; $ORACLE_PY gen_reference.py inputs.json > reference.json`.
- **Consumed by:** `tests/lunar_observability_numpy_oracle.rs`.
